repos_data.description: ⚙️  A dependency injection toolkit based on Go 1.18+ Generics.

Generic graph data structures and algorithms for Go (Golang): dependency graphs (DAGs) with cycle checks and topological sort, BFS and DFS traversal, Dijkstra and other shortest paths, connectivity and partitioning. No dependencies.
The missing context layer for AI-assisted refactoring
17 MCP query tools for codebase navigation — functions, classes, imports, dependency graphs, change impact. Zero dependencies. 87% token reduction.
Lightweight Go library for launching and coordinating components with dependency tracking, readiness probes, and graceful shutdown.

Turn any .NET test-automation solution into a queryable map in one SQLite file — features, steps, API clients, page objects, and their dependencies. Zero config, no AI, no network, 100% deterministic.

Index any TypeScript/React repo (incl. monorepos) into a queryable code graph — npx CLI, HTTP/WS + MCP server, 3D viewer. who-renders, who-calls, blast-radius, cycles, dead-code. npm: code-graph-indexer

Understand any codebase in 60 seconds - an MCP server, CLI and GitHub Action that turns any repo into an architecture diagram (Mermaid/Graphviz) and enforces architecture rules in CI. Works with Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and any MCP client.
